svg.aria-label: The ten Argo CD sync waves that bring up Atlas, from namespaces through the operators, the stateful Postgres and Kafka resources, Keycloak, the eight domain services and finally the KEDA autoscalers. Argo only advances to the next wave once the current one is Synced and Healthy.

svg.text: Argo advances to wave N+1 only once wave N is Synced + Healthy — the ordering the manual runbook does by hand, enforced by the tool.
